title: "Prediction Markets"
author: "Ángel Emilio Frías"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
#| cache: true
joined <- arrow::read_parquet("data/history.parquet") |>
  left_join(
    arrow::read_parquet("data/markets.parquet") |>
      select(market_id, outcome, resolved_at),
    by = "market_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric = if_else(outcome == "YES", 1L, 0L),
    distance = abs(outcome_numeric - probability),
    days_remaining = as.numeric(as.Date(resolved_at) - as.Date(date)),
    horizon = factor(
      case_when(
        days_remaining > 90 ~ "more than 90 days out",
        days_remaining > 30 & days_remaining <= 90 ~ "30 to 90",
        days_remaining > 7 & days_remaining <= 30 ~ "7 to 30",
        days_remaining >= 1 & days_remaining <= 7 ~ "1 to 7",
        days_remaining == 0 ~ "final day"
      ),
      levels = c(
        "more than 90 days out",
        "30 to 90",
        "7 to 30",
        "1 to 7",
        "final day"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

groups <- arrow::read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- arrow::read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")
accuracy <- joined |>
  group_by(horizon) |>
  summarize(
    mean_error = mean(distance),
    snapshots = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

accuracy

accuracy |>
  ggplot(aes(x = horizon, y = mean_error, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Time Horizon",
    y = "Mean Absolute Error"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
  final_day_snapshots <- joined |>
  filter(days_remaining == 0)

ggplot(final_day_snapshots, aes(x = probability)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0) +
  labs(
    title = "Forecast probabilities on resolution day",
    x = "Probability assigned to YES",
    y = "Number of snapshots"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
  calibration <- final_day_snapshots |>
  mutate(probability_midpoint = (as.numeric(cut(probability, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE)) - 0.5) / 10) |>
  group_by(probability_midpoint) |>
  summarize(
    actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

calibration

ggplot(calibration, aes(x = probability_midpoint, y = actual_rate)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(size = n)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Final-day forecasts track the 45-degree line of perfect calibration",
    x = "Forecasted Probability",
    y = "Actual Resolution Rate",
    size = "Markets"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
